title: Use CapCut Web → Video Studio to access Seedance 2.0 with omni reference support
content:
Use CapCut Web → Video Studio to access Seedance 2.0 with omni reference support  
Use CapCut Desktop → Media → AI Video to run text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) in Seedance 2.0  
Use CapCut App → AI Lab / AI Generator / AI Video to run text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) in Seedance 2.0
